provenance: R 4.6.1, package strucchange (Zeileis et al.), function breakpoints(y ~ 1, h=0.15), executed via validation/external/spec31_strucchange.R on tests/replication/data/spec31_synthetic.csv (n=180, seed=31, two known level breaks at 0-indexed t=59 and t=119). Raw R output: validation/results/external_logs/spec31_strucchange.log. Numeric capture: validation/external/spec31_strucchange.json.
notes: R's strucchange::breakpoints reports break numbers as the index of the last observation of a segment, 1-indexed but counted the same way as pyardl's 0-indexed break_indices convention (both name the observation right before the regime switch) — the raw integers 60 and 120 are directly comparable with no off-by-one adjustment, confirmed by exact SSR agreement below.
